About  Me

I'm a third-year Computer Science student at Injibara University, deeply passionate about software development, algorithms, and building real-world applications that solve meaningful problems.

My journey in tech has been driven by curiosity - from writing my first "Hello World" to developing full-stack web applications and exploring machine learning concepts. I thrive in collaborative environments and love turning ideas into working software.

When I'm not coding, you'll find me contributing to open-source projects, participating in competitive programming, or mentoring fellow students.
